reason: The goal calls for a water tank, but the board does not identify a ready-made one. Inspecting the steel should clarify how to make it.
expectation: The compatibility list should show which available part can be used to build the tank.

alternatives.reason: The tool might shape the steel into a tank, but its required construction is not yet clear.

effect: The steel and tool made a vented heating-water tank; it still needs a separate coolant coil.
reaction: The automatic construction clarified the next fitting.
reason: The coolant tubing is the natural material for the coil inside the tank.
expectation: The tubing will form a separate heat-exchange coil in the tank.

effect: The tank now has a sealed coolant coil but still needs water and insulation.
reaction: The separate circuits make the heat exchange clear.
reason: The tank needs heating water around the coil.
expectation: The tank will fill with water while the coolant remains confined to the coil.

alternatives.reason: Insulating the tank first could also help retain its stored heat.

effect: The tank is filled around the separate coolant coil, but its outer wall still needs insulation.
reason: Reflective insulation should reduce heat loss from the filled tank.
expectation: The insulation will wrap the tank and help retain its stored warmth.

effect: The filled tank is insulated, but its coil still needs a heat source.
reaction: The separate fluid paths and open vent make the setup clear.
reason: The indoor heat-recovery connection should supply the coil with process heat.
expectation: The tank's coil will connect to the heat-recovery loop, allowing it to warm the stored water.

effect: The heat-recovery connection warmed the insulated tank and completed the goal.
reaction: It was satisfying to see process heat put to use, though exposing the warm steel to the room was only briefly explained.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the separate coolant coil made the heat exchange physically understandable: process coolant transfers warmth to stored water without mixing with it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling and insulating the tank were sensible but predictable once its requirements were stated.

surprise.text: Inspecting the steel automatically built the tank; I expected a compatibility list rather than immediate construction.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The tank, coil, water, insulation and heat connection all had clear purposes.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the discovery and return develop; this chapter's practical heat-recovery explanation was useful, even if its steps were straightforward.
